gaps.title: Saved Searches and Favorites
gaps.jtbd: When using the system frequently, I want to save my search queries and favorite materials, so that I can quickly access them later without repeating complex searches.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given an authenticated user, When they choose to save a search or favorite a document, Then the system securely stores and allows retrieval of these preferences.
gaps.reason: literal brief requirement: 'возможность сохранения поисковых запросов и избранных материалов'

gaps.title: Document Comments and Update Requests
gaps.jtbd: When viewing a document, I want to leave comments or send an update request, so that I can provide feedback on outdated or unclear information.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given a document view, When a user submits a comment or update request, Then the system records it and notifies the responsible content managers.
gaps.reason: literal brief requirement: 'возможность комментирования и отправки запросов на актуализацию'

gaps.title: Date and Education Level Search Filters
gaps.jtbd: When searching for documents, I want to filter by update date and education level, so that I can easily narrow down results to the most relevant materials.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given the search interface, When a user applies date or education level filters, Then the system returns only documents matching those specific criteria.
gaps.reason: literal brief requirement: 'фильтры по типу документа, специальности, уровню образования, дате обновления'

gaps.title: Authentication and Session Management
gaps.jtbd: When accessing the system, I want to authenticate using my corporate credentials or login/password, so that my identity is verified and my role permissions are enforced securely.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given an unauthenticated user, When they provide valid login credentials, Then the system issues a secure session token rather than trusting unverified HTTP headers.
gaps.reason: literal brief requirement: 'авторизация через корпоративную учётную запись или по логину/паролю'

gaps.title: Search Auto-Suggestions
gaps.jtbd: When typing a query in the search bar, I want to see real-time auto-suggestions, so that I can find materials faster and correct my input on the fly.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given a search input field, When a user starts typing, Then the system returns a list of suggested queries or matching document titles.
gaps.reason: literal brief requirement: 'автоподсказки и исправление опечаток'

gaps.title: Offline Material Creation and Sync
gaps.jtbd: When I have no internet access, I want to be able to add materials offline, so that my work is saved locally and synchronized to the server when connection is restored.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given an offline state, When a user creates or modifies a document, Then it is stored locally and automatically pushed to the server upon reconnection.
gaps.reason: literal brief requirement: 'Возможность добавления материалов в офлайн-режиме с последующей синхронизацией'

gaps.title: Pagination for Document Lists and Search
gaps.jtbd: When retrieving a large set of documents or search results, I want the results to be paginated, so that the application loads quickly and does not fetch too much data at once.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given a search or list request, When there are more results than the page size, Then the API returns a paginated response indicating total count and current page data.
gaps.reason: domain-standard expectation: Public list endpoints for a large knowledge base require pagination to prevent performance degradation.
